data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Zama was a nymph who was known for her memory and recollection. She was often invoked by poets and scholars seeking inspiration and knowledge. In Christianity, Zama is not directly referenced in the Bible, but the name carries the symbolism of remembrance and reverence for the past. The name Zama carries the meaning “Memory, Recollection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zama usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, recollection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
